services.label: Incorporation Of Company / Business Formation
services.intro: We provide end-to-end company incorporation and business formation services across all entity types in India. From name reservation to post-incorporation compliance setup, we ensure your business is established on a legally sound footing.

sections.heading: Our Process
items: Name availability check & reservation via RUN/RUN-LLP
Drafting of Memorandum & Articles of Association (MOA/AOA)
Obtaining Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) & Director Identification Number (DIN)
Filing SPICe+, AGILE-PRO forms with MCA
PAN, TAN, GST, EPFO & ESIC registration

sections.heading: Why It Matters
items: Enables access to formal financing and investment
Ensures eligibility for government schemes & contracts
Establishes credibility with clients and partners

services.label: Company Law Services
services.intro: Our company law services encompass all secretarial and compliance requirements under the Companies Act, 2013. We help companies maintain statutory registers, file requisite forms with the ROC, and manage board and shareholder meetings.

sections.heading: Annual Compliance
items: Maintenance of Statutory Registers (MGT-1, SH-2, MBP-1, etc.)
Secretarial Audit Report (MR-3 for applicable companies)

sections.heading: Event-Based Compliance
items: Change in Directors / Key Managerial Personnel

sections.heading: Advisory & Drafting
items: Legal opinions on Companies Act provisions
Compounding of offences & condonation of delay

services.label: Corporate Restructuring
services.intro: Corporate restructuring is often necessary to improve efficiency, reduce debt, align business strategy, or facilitate expansion. We provide comprehensive secretarial and advisory support for all restructuring activities under the Companies Act and NCLT.

sections.heading: Restructuring Mechanisms
items: Buyback of securities (open market & tender offer)

sections.heading: Secretarial Support
items: Filing with NCLT, ROC and SEBI (if listed)

sections.heading: Strategic Advisory
items: Tax efficiency analysis (in collaboration with tax advisors)

services.label: Audit & Certification
services.intro: We offer a range of audit and certification services to ensure your company meets statutory obligations and is in good standing with regulatory authorities. Our certifications are relied upon by boards, investors, and regulators alike.

sections.heading: Secretarial Audit
items: Secretarial Audit Report in Form MR-3
Applicable to listed companies and large unlisted public companies
Covers compliance under Companies Act, SCRA, SEBI regulations, FEMA, and sector-specific laws
Annual secretarial compliance report for listed companies

sections.heading: Other Certifications
items: Diligence Report for creation of charges
Due Diligence Certificate for banks and financial institutions
PAS-6 (half yearly Reconciliation of Share Capital Audit Report)
Certification of e-forms filed with the ROC

sections.heading: Audit Support Services
items: Preparation of compliance reports for statutory auditors
Internal audit support for secretarial matters
Audit trail maintenance for corporate actions
Liaison with regulatory bodies during audits

services.label: SEBI & Listing
services.intro: For listed companies and those seeking to list, compliance with SEBI regulations and stock exchange requirements is critical. We provide end-to-end support for SEBI filings, continuous disclosure obligations, and listing-related compliance.

sections.heading: SEBI Filings & Transactions
items: Takeover Code (SEBI SAST) compliance and filings
Rights Issue, QIP & FPO secretarial support

sections.heading: IPO & Listing Advisory
items: Coordination with SEBI, stock exchanges and registrars

services.label: Applications & Approval
services.intro: Dealing with government bodies and regulatory authorities requires precision, documentation expertise, and procedural knowledge. We handle all corporate applications and approval processes on your behalf.

sections.heading: MCA / ROC Applications
items: NCLT petitions for company law matters

sections.heading: Government & Statutory Bodies
items: RBI approval for investments & transactions (where applicable)
Sectoral regulatory approvals (SEBI, IRDAI, RBI, etc.)

sections.heading: Other Approvals
items: Liaison with ROC, Regional Director and MCA

services.label: Foreign Exchange Management
services.intro: Foreign investments, overseas transactions, and cross-border corporate structures are governed by FEMA and RBI regulations. We provide expert advisory and compliance support for all foreign exchange related matters.

sections.heading: Inbound Investment Compliance
items: FDI compliance under FEMA (Non-Debt Instruments) Rules
FC-GPR filing for foreign equity issuances
FC-TRS filing for share transfers involving non-residents
Reporting of foreign investment on FIRMS portal

sections.heading: Outbound Investment
items: Joint Venture / Wholly Owned Subsidiary abroad

sections.heading: Other FEMA Services
items: Advisory on sectoral caps and prohibited sectors
FEMA due diligence for M&A transactions

services.label: Project Financing
services.intro: Securing project finance requires meticulous documentation, regulatory compliance, and corporate structuring. We assist businesses in fulfilling all secretarial, legal, and compliance requirements to facilitate smooth project financing.

sections.heading: Secretarial Support for Financing
items: Board and shareholder resolutions for loans & borrowings
Creation and registration of charges (CHG-1, CHG-9)
Modification and satisfaction of charges (CHG-1, CHG-4)

sections.heading: Regulatory Filings
items: Drafting Resolutions for exercising borrowing powers
RBI reporting for ECBs and structured debt
SEBI compliance for listed debt instruments

sections.heading: Due Diligence & Advisory
items: Coordination with legal counsel and financial advisors

services.label: Closure Of Business
services.intro: Closing a business requires navigating multiple regulatory processes to ensure no pending liabilities, proper distribution of assets, and clean deregistration. We manage the complete closure process efficiently and compliantly.

sections.heading: Voluntary Strike-Off (Fast Track)
items: Preparation of STK-2 application and affidavits
NOC from banks, creditors and tax authorities
Filing with ROC and follow-up till gazette notification

sections.heading: Winding Up
items: Voluntary Winding Up under Companies Act 2013
Final accounts and distribution of assets

sections.heading: LLP & Other Entity Closure
items: Cancellation of GST, PAN, and other registrations

services.label: Mutual Fund Services
services.intro: Mutual funds provide a structured and diversified route to wealth creation. We assist clients in selecting, managing, and optimizing mutual fund investments aligned with their financial goals, risk appetite, and time horizon.

sections.heading: Investment & Advisory
items: Risk profiling and goal-based financial planning
Selection of mutual fund schemes (Equity, Debt, Hybrid, ELSS)
SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) and lump sum investment guidance

sections.heading: Portfolio Management & Compliance
items: Documentation, account setup, and regulatory compliance
Capital gains tracking and tax-efficient structuring

sections.heading: Redemption & Investor Support
items: Fund switching and exit strategy advisory
Coordination with AMCs / RTAs and grievance handling

services.label: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR)
services.intro: Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) safeguard your innovations, brand identity, and creative assets. We provide end-to-end support for registration, protection, and enforcement of intellectual property, ensuring your rights are legally secured and commercially leveraged.

sections.heading: Registration & Advisory
items: Patent filing support and documentation coordination
Brand name and logo protection guidance

sections.heading: Compliance & Portfolio Management
items: Renewal and maintenance of IP rights
Due diligence and IP audit support
Compliance with applicable IP laws and regulations

sections.heading: Enforcement & Legal Support
items: Support in dispute resolution and litigation coordination
Advisory on commercialization and monetization of IP

services.label: Other Varied Services
services.intro: Beyond our core offerings, we provide a range of specialised and customised professional services to cater to the evolving and unique needs of our clients across industries.

sections.heading: Documentation & Drafting
items: Shareholders' Agreement (SHA) & Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) drafting
Employment contracts and HR policy manuals
